title: Is AI Cold Calling Legal? Yes. Your Script Has Two Seconds.
meta_description: AI cold calling is legal in the United States, and no federal rule makes you announce that the caller is AI. The FCC classified AI generated voices as artificial voices in 2024, which puts your agent under the prerecorded message rules: written consent, your registered legal name at the top of the call, and an automated opt out within two seconds.
